reponse: The root cause was the broker ingest-kafka-2 running out of disk after the retention change in infra PR #221 removed size-based retention, leaving only 7-day time-based retention; the broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and consumers stalled [2][3]. The outage lasted 2h47m (09:38–12:25 UTC), with events delayed up to that long but none lost since producers buffered [2]. Consumers logged NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS and 18,402 KafkaConsumerTimeout errors on group ingest-events between 09:39 and 12:24 UTC [1][4]. The earlier suspect, PR #388 raising the insert batch size from 500 to 5000, was a red herring: reverting it (commit 9c1e2fa) did not stop the lag, and the change was re-applied on Friday [1][3][5]. Follow-up actions include an 80% disk alert and restoring size-based retention [5].
